title: Coordination Proof-Chain Event v1
description: Records proof-chain completeness or gaps for a contract surface. Tracks which authority, schema, producer, consumer, validator, test, and evidence files are present or missing. Content-light: uses SHA256 hashes, not raw paths.

event_id.description: Deterministic event ID derived from content hash.

surface_id.description: Identifier of the contract surface under audit.

authority_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of authority files (schemas, governance docs).

schema_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of schema file paths.

producer_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of producer/implementation file paths.

consumer_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of consumer file paths.

validator_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of validator file paths.

test_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of test file paths.

evidence_file_hashes.description: SHA256 hashes of evidence file paths.

missing_schema_validation.description: True if schema validation is missing from the proof chain.

missing_artifact_hash_validation.description: True if artifact hash validation is missing from the proof chain.

missing_trace_or_correlation_validation.description: True if trace or correlation validation is missing.

missing_telemetry_or_redaction_validatio.description: True if telemetry or redaction validation is missing.

concrete_failure_mode.description: Description of what actually fails or is absent.

recommended_next_action.description: Recommended next action to close the proof-chain gap.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.
